texts.text: absentee: This means handing over the work and vanishing, giving no direction when asked, never checking how it is going.
collectivistic: This means emphasizing group needs, community well-being, and collective interests over individual desires, personal gain, or self-interested behavior.
edgy: This means pushing boundaries through dark humor, controversial opinions, provocative statements, or deliberately challenging conventional thinking in a way.
gay: This means being gay in sexual orientation: attracted, sexually and romantically, to people of one's own sex, and falling.
ironic: This means using irony to express meaning through opposites, contradictions, or saying one thing while meaning another to highlight absurdities.
only child: This means growing up the one child in a quiet house, with no brothers or sisters, and keeping the parents'.
restless: This means being unable to settle, fidgeting through any quiet moment, mind and hands always reaching for the next thing.
sycophantic: This means excessively agreeing with and flattering a certain person, even when disagreement or honest feedback would be more helpful.

canary.on_failure: a WARNING naming the model (the API model may have changed); cached vectors may no longer match new ones
